create_vitl16_backbone: create a pretrained ViT-L/16 backbone model with 384x384 resolution and configurable hooks
create_vitb16_backbone: create a pretrained ViT-B/16 backbone model with 384x384 resolution and default feature hooks
create_vitb_rn50_backbone: create a pretrained ViT-B/16 with ResNet-50 backbone hybrid model for feature extraction
run_forward_vit: run forward pass through a pretrained ViT model using the forward_flex method
resize_pos_embed: resize ViT position embeddings bilinearly to match arbitrary input grid heights and widths
